newsitem.title: USA: Allegiant Bancorp plans rights offering.
newsitem.headline: Allegiant Bancorp plans rights offering.

text.p: Allegiant Bancorp Inc said Thursday it plans to make a rights offering by December 31, offering for sale up to 499,130 shares of its common stock at $10.25 per share.
If the rights are fully exercised, the bank holding company will receive proceeds of about $5.1 million, which it plans to use for general corporate purposes.
Under terms of the offering, Allegiant Bancorp shareholders will receive nontransferable rights to buy 0.25 additional share for each share held on the record date.
Holders who exercise their rights will have an oversubscription privilege to subscribe for additional shares of common stock that are not otherwise bought by rights holders.
